thesis: Make the title literal by narrating dawn as a physical light journey: pre-dawn indigo, horizon amber bleed, and full-sun gold/white arrival with widening counter-sweeps.

artist_branding.summary: Coste-style melodic/progressive house reads as warm, uplifting, and patiently layered; the visual strategy should privilege long-form optimism over aggressive hard-edged shock moments.
visual_cues: Naturalistic dawn color progression from indigo to amber to gold-white
Patient build mechanics with physically legible movement arcs
Warm optimistic peak language supported by coherent geometric storytelling
do_not_copy: Avoid copying exact sunrise visual edits or direct recreation of external show cue timelines.

motifs: Geometry motif: profile arc tracks sunrise elevation while Sharpy/BSW counter-sweeps widen the horizon
Color motif: indigo and violet pre-dawn to amber and warm gold full-day illumination
Movement motif: gradual reveal steps where each phrase adds one additional intensity or texture layer

visual_direction.color_story: Progress from deep night indigo through first-light amber into saturated gold and warm-white climax, then taper back into soft dusk remnants.
visual_direction.motion_story: Use long smooth transitions for intro/break and clearer directional drive in drops so sunrise acceleration is physically obvious.
visual_direction.staging_story: Center profile trajectory functions as the sunrise clock while opposing Sharpy/BSW travel paints horizon expansion across the room.

must_include: A clear dawn progression with no abrupt cold-palette reset mid-story
Counter-sweep behavior where Sharpy and BSW often travel in opposite directions
Late-peak intensity escalation that feels earned by the preceding build
avoid: Early peak blasting that removes sunrise narrative shape
Random palette swaps unrelated to dawn progression
Dense strobe-heavy treatments that break warm melodic tone
